stories.title: Democrat Endorses Republican in Michigan Senate Race
stories.sum: Haley Stevens, a former congresswoman, has endorsed Republican candidate Mike Rogers in a competitive Michigan Senate race. This unexpected endorsement comes just days before the crucial vote.
stories.more: Stevens previously lost the Democratic nomination to Abdul El-Sayed, making her endorsement particularly significant in the context of party tensions. The backing of Rogers could provide a valuable advantage to the Republican party in a race that is pivotal for control of Congress. Both articles highlight a notable shift in party loyalty, with BBC News focusing on the escalation of party disputes while RTE emphasizes the implications for the upcoming midterm elections.

stories.title: Haley Stevens Endorses Republican Mike Rogers, Dividing Democrats
stories.sum: Democratic Rep. Haley Stevens has publicly endorsed Republican Mike Rogers for the US Senate in Michigan. This endorsement comes amid a contentious rivalry with Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed.
stories.more: The endorsement is seen as a significant defection from Stevens, who was expected to support her party's candidate. This move could impact voter sentiment and the dynamics of the upcoming elections. Different outlets may emphasize the dramatic nature of the endorsement and its potential consequences for party unity.
